text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, the ocean! Mmh~, visibility for 100 
miles!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You can smell the tide, too. Doesn't it 
just get you so excited~?♪"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the sea like this... it really 
hits home that we've come close to the 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I hope it turns out to be a 
wonderful summer training camp for 
everyone—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...It's starting. The summer training 
camp that will determine our autumn—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Gran-chan is going to focus on sprints 
and miles starting this autumn, so she'll 
be walking a different path from mine.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(On the other hand, I've heard Chrono-chan 
and Bouquet-chan plan to focus mainly on 
medium-distance races after the Shuka 
Sho...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...Everyone has something they want to 
achieve on their own path. I know they 
chose their path for that very reason—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Running toward the Shuka Sho right now is 
definitely connected to what I want to do 
and the love I want to fulfill. I have no 
doubts about that.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Yet at the same time, I can't help but 
think...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(With everyone and Trainer-kun by my 
side... I feel like we can discover a path 
even more wonderful than where we are 
now――)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(With everyone and Trainer-chan by my 
side... I feel like we can discover a path 
even more wonderful than where we are 
now――)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...It feels like I'm getting swallowed by 
the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hm? Love-chan, did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— I was just thinking about how vast 
the sea is♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Loves Only You's summer training 
camp was about to begin—
